info.event: Severe Thunderstorm and Lightning Strike Warning
info.headline: Orange Alert: Moderate to Severe Thunderstorms with Frequent Cloud-to-Ground Lightning in Patna
info.description: Active convective storm cluster moving eastward producing frequent cloud-to-ground lightning, gusty squall winds of 50-60 kmph, and intense rain bursts across Patna district.
info.instruction: Take immediate shelter inside permanent pucca buildings. Avoid taking shelter under isolated trees, metal sheds, or mobile towers. Farmers are advised to suspend agricultural operations immediately.
